title: Reaxys v1.x stocking-queue probe roster -- the P1+P2 tier, split into what the W17 thin-family lanes already walked and what is still unprobed
purpose: the Week 17 plan names the Reaxys stocking queue (P1 = 2 / P2 = 22 / P3 = 143) as the compound-expansion channel for the thin families; this roster locks the next probe set before any query is run, and recomputes the already-walked split from the probe artefacts instead of trusting the queue's own stale flag

scope.why_p3_excluded: P3 is 143 rows and is a family-heuristic tail, not a usability claim; it is left for a later batch so this roster stays reviewable by hand

rules.already_probed: a queue row is already_probed when its InChIKey appears in the *inchikey* column of any prior probe artefact listed above, or when the queue itself carries probed_in_this_round = yes.  The two rules are unioned on purpose: the CSV artefacts are key-asserted, while the Week 13 v1.x probe half was transcribed by name and is therefore only reachable through the queue flag.
rules.probe_order: probe_target rows first, ordered by tier (P1 before P2) then by queue_rank; already_probed rows last, also by queue_rank.  Rows flagged aromatic_non_electrolyte_suspect sink to the tail of their tier -- they are still in the roster, never silently dropped.
rules.aromatic_non_electrolyte_suspect: family_tag == fluorinated AND the SMILES carries an aromatic carbon (lowercase c).  The Week 17 plan warns that the fluorinated substring rule drags non-electrolyte aromatics (fluorotoluenes, fluorobenzene, difluorobenzene, benzotrifluoride) into P2; the flag marks them for manual review rather than pretending they are electrolyte solvents.

channel_definitions.orbital: Ionization Potential + Calculated Properties (Reaxys labels this block Quantum Chemical Calculations on some cards)
channel_definitions.redox: Electrochemical Characteristics only; Electrochemical Behaviour is deliberately excluded
channel_definitions.comment_rule: the Reaxys Comment column carries values on some cards (11 of 21 eta points in W17-15); the Comment column must be read as well and its provenance recorded

counting_semantics.rows: category rows Reaxys reports (every category table expanded to the row count Reaxys itself prints)
counting_semantics.valued: the value cell is populated; a Reaxys range counts as valued
counting_semantics.point: the whole value cell parses as a single float
counting_semantics.never_conflated: rows / valued / point are three separate tallies and are never added, subtracted or substituted for one another
counting_semantics.units: Reaxys reports its own units and they are preserved, not repaired; T_K is a deterministic conversion of the Celsius column, ranges stay ranges, nothing is averaged and nothing is imputed to 298.15 K

compliance.key_rule: every substance key is taken verbatim from the queue's inchikey column; hand-typed keys are banned
compliance.raw_evidence_dir: data/raw/reaxys_w17d (git-ignored, kept verbatim on this machine)
compliance.browser: the author's already signed-in Reaxys session, one substance card at a time; no profile copy, no fresh login, no headless scraping, no bulk export

acceptance: the roster CSV has exactly the P1+P2 rows of the queue, with no row invented and none dropped
every roster key appears verbatim in the queue's inchikey column (keys_not_from_the_queue == 0)
probe_status is recomputed from the prior artefacts, not copied from the queue flag
the roster is a plan: it runs no query and carries no Reaxys value
